name: mesurer-codex
description: Powers Mesurer Settings → Codex from browser pages by keeping a local loopback bridge connected to Codex Desktop or CLI sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Mesurer's in-app Codex feature to local Codex sessions
interface.longDescription: Local transport helper for Mesurer's own Settings → Codex integration. It starts or reuses the loopback companion, registers Codex sessions, and lets browser-hosted Mesurer queue Context feedback to Codex Desktop or CLI. This is separate from the Mesurer Solid ChatGPT/Codex agent plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use Mesurer feedback in this project.
